content: Majigano nnani ja Lichobha lya Kupomolela

Gono muda, lichobha limo lya kupomolela Ayesu bhakibha bhatenda kupeta mu migonda ja ngaano. Penapo bhabhaajigana bhabhe bhakakola njala, na bhena angota bhakajemeka kukwachula maache na kupikicha mapemba na kutaunanga njelegwa jabhe.
Mafalisayo pabhakalola genago, bhakaalobholela Ayesu, “Nnole! Bhabhaajigana bhinu bhatendanga chilebhe changapalikwa mu malagilo ga Lichobha lya Kupomolela.”
Ayesu bhakaajangula, “Bholi, mwangachoma chibhakatenda Adaudi na akaajabhe pabhakibha na njala?
Akajingilanga mu Nyuumba ja Annoongo bhakalyee jenijela mikate jijikabhekwa nnongi ja Annoongo. Bhenabho na akaajabhe bhangapalikwa kulyee mikate hejo nambo akaakung'i jikajabhe.

Bholi, mwangachomanga mu Malagilo ga Amusa gagakalobhola kila Lichobha lya Kupomolela Akaakung'i bhagaalibiana Malagilo ga Lichobha lya Kupomolela mu Nyuumba ja Annoongo kwa kutenda gangapalikwa mu Lichobha lya Kupomolela, nambo ngaganikiwa kubhee bhatenda kulemwa?
Bahi, nannobholelanga yakubhee pambani pabhile na akolo kupunda Nyuumba ja Annoongo.
Handa nkahimanyite maana gakwe malobhe gangani, ‘Mbala kwabhonelanga kiha na ngabha mbeeko,’ nkahukumulinge hopo bhandu bhangalemwa.
Kwa kubhee Mwana bha Mundu nga bhabhatabhala mu Lichobha lya kupomolela.”
Ayesu bhaalamia amundu jwaapolite lubhoko
Ayesu bhakabhoka penapo, bhakajenda mu Nyuumba ja konganilananga Bhayahudi.

Monomwe akibha mundu jumo jwapolite lubhoko. Bahi bhandu bhakaakonya Ayesu, “Bholi, hipalikwa kunlamia mundu Lichobha lya Kupomolela?” Bhakaakonya henela kwaapala atangile bhapatange ndela ja kwaahukumula.
Nambo Ayesu akaalobholela, “Tulobhole abhi mundu nkati jinu jwabhile na ngondolo jwabhe atekujingila mu liembo, bholi, ngaakamula na kummoa kwa kubhee nga Lichobha lya Kupomolela?
Nambo mundu nga bhammbone kupunda ngondolo! Bahi, hipalikwa kutenda gammbone mu Lichobha lya Kupomolela.”
Ngapena Ayesu bhakaalobholela bheni bhala mundu, “Nnyulule lubhoko lwinu.” Nga bhakagunyulula, lubhoko gukalama gukabhee gumomi handa gonigola gongi.
Bahi, Mafalisayo bhakabhoka panja, bhakabhekanga chikomiti chibhou chakupala kwaakoma Ayesu.
Antumichi bhabhaagulikwe na Annoongo
Nambo Ayesu pabhakajoa genigala bhakabhoka penipala. Bhandu bhajingi bhakaakagula nga bhakaalamia akaatamwa bhoa.
Bhakaakanikia bhakoto kwaalobholela bhandu hikubho yabhe.
Akatenda henela kupala genigala gagalongolikwe na Annoongo kwa ndela ja alondoi Aisaya gapate kukweela

content.text: mpaliyon bhangu naampalite muno mu ntima gwangu.
na bhenabho bhapakutangacha hukumu jangu kwa bhandu bhanga Bhayahudi.
Bhapakubhee hopo na kutaukana wala kupota nyenye,
na bhaakwa mundu bhabhapakujoha lilobhe lyabhe lipakujohanika hopo mu ndela.
Kwa lina lyabhe bhandu bhanga Bhayahudi bhapakuhobhalela kwa bhenabho.”

content: Ayesu na Abelizebuli
Penapo bhandu bhakaaletela Ayesu mundu bhamo bhangalola na bhangakombola kulongela, kwa kubhee bhakibha bhatekuchukilwa na mahoka. Ayesu bhakaalamia penapo bhakakombola kulongela na kulola.
Bhandu bhoa bhakakangachanga na kulobholanga, “Bholi, komboleka habha nga Mwana bha Adaudi?”
Nambo Mafalisayo pabhakajoha genago, bhakalobhola, “Habha mundu bhatenda kugabhoa mahoka kwa machili bhabhagapatite kubhoka kwa akolo bha mahoka bhabhakemitwa Abelizebuli.”

Ayesu bhakibha bhagamanya bhabhaganikia, bhakaaalobholela, “Umwenye goa gola gugumetunike kwa malubhalo gagapotana, ngakombola kutama machobha goa na chilambo choachela au akaalongo bhoabhala bhabhametunike malubhalo malubhalo gagatekukanangana, gapakugwee.
Handa Lichetani lijomana na Lichetani lijakwe bhatenda kuchimetula bheene mu mabhoga mabhoga bheene. Bahi umwenye gwabhe gupakujema bholi?

Mwangota ntenda kulobholanga nenga ndenda kugabhutua mahoka kwa machili ga Abelizebuli, bholi bhandu bhinu bhagabhenga mahoka kwa machili ga aganiki? Ligongo helyo bhenaangota nga bhapakunhukumulanga mwangota.
Nambo handa nenga ndenda kugabhutua mahoka kwa machili ga Annoongo, bahi mmanyange yakubhee umwenye gwa Annoongo guikite kwaachinu.”

“Bhaakwa mundu bhabhakombola kujingila mu nyuumba ja mundu jwaabhikle na machili na kwaapoka hilebhe yabhe, pangali kwaatabha oti jono mundu jwabhi na machili? Mpalikwa oti kwaatabha penapo nga pampakombola kwaapoka hilebhe yabhe.”
“Mundu bhoa bhala bhangalondanika na nenga, bhangana nenga, na bhoa bhala bhangakondanika pamo na nenga bhatenda kupwilingania.
Nangocheni nannobholelanga, bhandu bhapakulekelelwa mabhou gabhenji na matukano gabhe goa, nambo bhandu ngalekelelwa mabhou gabhe ga kwaaponja Mboomo ja Annoongo.

Kabhele, bhabhapakulobhola lilobhe lya kwaakana Mwana bha Mundu bhabhapakulekelelwa mabhou gabhe, nambo bhenibhala bhabhapakulobhola lilobhe lya kunkana Mboomo Ja Annoongo ngalekelelwa mabhou gabhe, ngabha mu chenje chilambo au mu chilambo chichipakuhika.”
Nkongo na matunda gabhe
“Nkongo gwa kuhalala guogola matunda gakuhalala, na nkongo gwangammbone guhogola matunda gabhou. Nkongo gwamanyika kwa matunda gabhe gagabheleka.

Mwangota nga mwangalimmbone handa majoka gagabhile na uchoongo! Mkombolanga bholi kulobhola hilebhe yammbone na kongo mmile akaabhou? Kwa kubhee amundu bhatenda kulobhola kubhokana na genigala gagabhile muntima gwabhe.
Mundu bhakuhalala bhagapia gagabhile gakuhalala kubhoka muntima gwabhe, na amundu abhou bhapia hilebhe hibhou kubhoka muntima gwabhe.”
“Bahi, ndendakunnobholelanga, lichobha lya hukumu kila amundu bhapalikwa kulongela nnani ja kila lilobhe lyangammbone libhalongile.
Kwa malobhe ginu mpakubhonekana mwangalimmbone, na kwa malobhe ginu mpakuhukumulwa kubhee bha kulemwa.”
Kupala kuibhona yakangachika
Kubhoka penapo bhabhajigana Malagilo ga Amusa na Mafalisayo bhakaalobholela Ayesu, “Bhannyigana, tupala kuibhona yakangachika kubhoka kwaachinu.”
Nambo Ayesu bhakaajangula, “Chibhelei changaamanya Annoongo! Mpalanga hilolelo, nambo chibhelei heche ngapata hilolelo yoha yela nambo jeni jela hilolelo ya alondoi Ayona.
Handa henela Ayona chibhakatama machobha gatatu muhi na kilo mulutumbo lwa hoomba, nga chiipakubhee kwa bhena Mwana bha Amundu chibhapakutama pahi ja undopi kwa machobha gatatu muhi na kilo.

Bhandu bha kubhoka chilambo cha ku Ninawi bhapakubhokela Lichobha lya Kuhukumulwa, na bhenaangota bhapakuchikopokea chenje chibhelei chichitekulemwite. Kwa kubhehe bhandu bha chilambo cha ku Ninawi bhenaangota bhakalekanga gabhou gabhe ligongo lya kutangacha kwa Ayona, na pamba bhabhi akolongwa kupunda Ayona!

Haikege bha kuchini bhapakujema muda kwa chebhelei chenjeni pachipakuhumuluwa, na bhenabho bhapakuchikupokea kwakubhee chilemwite. Kwa kubhehe bhenabho bhakajaula ulendo kubhoka kutali, bhakahika kugajohanikia malobhe ga malango ga Asolomoni, na pamba nangocheni bhabhile akolongwa kwaapunda Asolomoni.”
Kubhuja kwa lihoka
“Muuda lihoka palyabhoka amundu, lihoka lityanga tyanga panga machi bhabhikulolea amundu bha kwaajingila na bhangaapata.
Penapo bhabhikuchilobholela, ‘Mbakubhuja ku nyuumba jangu kumokite.’ Na bhenabho pabhapakubhuja kujikolela jela nyuumba jikibha janga chilebhe, jitekupyagilwa na kubhekwa maha,

Ngapena bhajenda na kubhatola mahoka bhangi saba, bhabhilinge na machili kupunda bhenabho, na bhoa bhatenda kuhika na kwaajingila bhena amundu. Na bhena mundu bhabhee na abhou kupunda pena kandahi. Nga chiipakubhehe kwa habha bhandu akaabhou.”
Akaalongo na anyongo bha kweli bha Ayesu
Ayesu bhakibha tangu bhatendakulongela na nkutuli gwa bhandu muda gono anyongo mundu na akaanung'una bhabhe bhakahikanga kujema panja, bhakapalanga kulongela na bhenabho.
Nnole, amundu bhamo bhakaalobholela Ayesu, “Anyongo bhinu na anung'una bhinu bhabhi panja, bhapala kulongela na mwenga.”
Ayesu bhakaajangula bhena amundu, “Anyongo bhangu nga bheneki? Na anung'una bhangu nga bheneki?”
Ngapena bhakagunyolola lubhoko lwabhe na kwaalangia bhabhaajigana bhabhe, bhakalobhola, “Habha nga anyongo bhangu na anung'una bhangu!
Kwa kubhehe bhoabhala bhabhatenda chibhapala Atati bhangu bhabhile kunani kulihunde kwa Annoongo, bhenabho nga anung'una bhangu na alombo bhandu na anyongo bhangu.”
